messages:
zoe: quick probe  new idea: put a compact legend bar under the heatmap with a small sampling CTA that opens per-route quick actions. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/legend-cta.png
liam: I like it. The CTA could be a tiny kebab or a chip that says "Sampling: 1-in-20". click opens options: preview traces, override rate, pin.
aisha: accessibility: make the CTA keyboard tabbable and expose the menu via Enter/Space. menu items should be real buttons, not links. also aria-haspopup and aria-expanded states.
zoe: agree. Also want a succinct tooltip: "Sampling: 1-in-20 (5%) \nClick to manage sampling for this route". keeps jargon low.
liam: UX nit: if we put the legend under the heatmap it competes for vertical space on small screens. Suggest hiding nonessential legend items in mobile and showing a "Legend" chevron.
aisha: for screen readers, collapse visually but keep sr-only indicator so SR users can still open it.
ux-bot: reminder: analytics API returns sample_rate float and sample_source string. UI must show both when available (e.g., "client-sampled").
zoe: thought: quick-actions menu could have a readonly preview row showing "p95: 120ms (approx, sampled)" and a small "View traces" link. clicking View traces opens side panel with trace list.
liam: caution: auto-fetching traces for many users will spike queries. make View traces a click-to-load action and show a skeleton while loading. debounce interactions.
aisha: keyboard flow: when the side panel opens, trap focus inside panel, first element focused is search, Esc closes and returns focus to original CTA. document this in AX checklist.
zoe: copy thought: replace "approx" with "approximate" in the p95 line? Feels clearer.
liam: +1. and show a small pill that says "sampled" in yellow when sample_rate < 1, and "full" in green otherwise. ensure contrast meets WCAG 4.5:1.
aisha: color accessibility: yellow pill needs dark text or darker outline; test on both light and dark themes. Also add a focus ring for pills for keyboard users.
ux-bot: note: display both fraction and percentage per product guidance: "1-in-20 (5%)". bots/telemetry will send sample_rate as 0.05 so UI should render fraction intelligently.
liam: interaction detail: if user changes time range while menu/panel is open, keep the menu open only if the route is still visible in the new range; otherwise close and show a toast: "Context changed  menu closed" with undo.
zoe: animation: menu open 100ms scale + fade, panel slide 140ms. prefer prefers-reduced-motion support to collapse to no-motion.
aisha: a11y nit: menu item labels should include the effect e.g., "Override sampling (temporary)" so assistive tech users know it's not permanent.
liam: operations ask: any override action must generate an audit event and optionally a banner: "Sampling override active on route X  Undo". Ops wants a toggle for auto-rollback after 24h.
ops-bot: reminder: log events should include user id, route id, previous rate, new rate, and timestamp. Include an event for pin/unpin.
zoe: mobile: put quick actions in the route overflow (three dots) and swap the legend into a dropdown to save vertical space.
aisha: QA checklist for PR: keyboard nav for legend & menu, ARIA attributes for menu/pills, color contrast checks, side-panel focus trap, reduced-motion behavior, analytics events for overrides, toast undo path.
liam: final UX copy tweak: tooltip header: "Sampling (how metrics were computed)" and the body: "1-in-20 requests used to estimate metrics for this route." keeps it explicit without alarm.
zoe: great, I'll iterate the mock, update the palette/tokens, and open a PR with screenshots + the QA checklist. tagging @liam @aisha @ops-bot for review :thumbsup:
